X:1 T:Scraper Metaphor M:4/4 Q:1/4=120 L:1/8 K:C % Event-driven scraper adjusts Q: (tempo) and M: (meter) dynamically % Grace notes { } are parsed from HTML span.grace-note elements % Bars | are auto-generated on
tags during scraping V:Main | "Am"A2 "C"E2 "F"F2 "G"G2 | "Em"E2 "Dm"D2 "F"F2 "G"G2 | % Scraper inserts grace notes before 'B' if exists { "Am"B "G"A } "Em"B2 | "C"E2 "F"F2 "G"G2 "Am"A2 | % Dynamic tempo change via [Q:] on event 'accelerando' from scraper [Q:1/8=160] "C"c2 "F"f2 "G"g2 "Am"a2 | % Function: On scraping
, insert | and reset counter % Function: Parse to update Q:, defaulting to Q: before line w:Lyrics are scraped from

tags nightly % Grace note handler: Each becomes {note} pair % Meter modifier: Switch to M:6/8 if

# Define characters
define p = Character("Protagonist")
define m = Character("Mom")

# Flashback transition effect
define flash = Fade(0.5, 0.0, 0.5, color="#fff")

label start:
    scene bg room
    p "I remember that day clearly."

    # Enter flashback
    scene bg park with flash
    "The air smelled like rain and old memories."
    
    m "Don't forget your umbrella, dear."
    p "I won't, I promise!"
    
    "I ran toward the swings, unaware of what was coming."
    
    # Exit flashback
    scene bg room with flash
    p "If only I had listened."
    return
